const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /home/pjensen/Repos/JSHack/.agents/skills/add-enchantment-scroll/SKILL.md
+---
+name: add-enchantment-scroll
+description: Add a gear-enchanting scroll with a reusable passive or proc affix, recipe metadata, loot eligibility, and focused coverage to JSHack.
+---
+
+Add a new enchanting scroll to the roguelike. Use this skill when the scroll applies an existing or newly authored affix to equipment; ordinary spell scrolls belong in `add-item`.
+
+## Canonical authoring path
+
+1. Inspect `src/rules/content/enchanting/enchantCatalog.js` and `src/content/items/scrolls.js`.
+2. Add an immutable entry to `ENCHANT_SCROLL_DEFS` in `enchantCatalog.js`. Set its `itemId`, player-facing name, `affixId`, allowed gear slots, effect summary, flavor, and recipe requirements. The loop in `src/content/items/scrolls.js` generates the catalog item and apply/dip hooks from this definition.
+3. Reuse an existing affix from `src/rules/data/affixes.js` when the mechanic matches. If the stat/proc is genuinely new, add its deterministic passive or proc script and registry definition there, including supported slots and display text.
+4. Add the identity to `sub:scrolls` in `src/rules/data/lootTables.js` when it should be a normal drop. Do not add finished enchant scrolls to alchemy shop stock unless explicitly requested.
+5. Add a palette entry to `src/display/palette/base.js`; content-generated palette registration does not replace the base fallback entries used by existing enchant scrolls.
+6. Extend `tests/enchantingBench.test.mjs` for successful binding and `tests/enchantingContent.test.mjs` for loot/shop policy when the behavior changes.
+
+## Invariants
+
+- Keep the scroll's allowed slots aligned with both `enchantDefSupportsSlot()` and the affix registry's slot list.
+- The runtime affix id is the canonical gameplay effect; do not add a second bespoke hook for a stat already represented by an affix.
+- Recipe requirement keys use the named ingredient keys from `ENCHANTING_INGREDIENTS` (`emberRoot`, `beastClaw`, `gold`, and so on), not item identity strings.
+- Use deterministic existing pipelines; do not add world state or direct display/rules coupling.
+
+## Verification
+
+Run the focused suite:
+
+```bash
+deno test --allow-read tests/enchantingBench.test.mjs tests/enchantingContent.test.mjs tests/contentCatalogCanonical.test.mjs
+```
+
+For a new affix or broader wiring, also run `deno task check` and the agent-health script.
*** End Patch";
